name: contact-update
description: Update canonical profile attributes (job title, organization, timezone, phone, LinkedIn, etc.) on an existing contact. contact_id must be a UUID from contact-lookup or entity-context — do not invent IDs. Call this directly when a canonical attribute is learned about a known contact; do not route through memory-store.

inputs.fields: object (canonical fields to write — include only the fields being changed. Valid keys: preferredName, title, organization, primaryEmail, primaryPhone, timezone, locale, location, pronouns, linkedinUrl, bio, birthday. Pass null to clear a field.)
